vetSays.line: 📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Lena, Francisco, Ramon and Howard met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Lena, Francisco, Ramon, Howard are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hassan just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hassan just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lena, Ramon and Elijah met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Lena is hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elijah just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Maya met them at the door — 1 put down. Maya is hurt.
Maya keeps coming back to Maya’s tale of The Herald — and now has a beast to hunt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
Mangapul keeps coming back to Maya’s tale of Big Loud — and now has a beast to hunt.

killerTaleLog: [day 33] Asher: The fire settles. Asher has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hassan breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Lena says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 34] Francisco: The fire settles. Francisco has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Choir Toad — I put it down today." "Its throat swells. The air goes thick. Every frog for a mile answers at once." "It crouches — clumsy, obvious, and faster than it looks." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai mutters "So it bleeds." Elijah breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 35] Asher: The fire settles. Asher has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Understudy — I put it down today." "It watches your weapon. It lifts its own — a perfect, insulting copy at half fidelity." "It starts performing — and your most-used move is suddenly anticipated, halved, ANSWERED." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Meera mutters "Say that again — slower." Fatima breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 35] Hassan: The fire settles. Hassan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Chorus Line — I put it down today." "The music starts — an actual audio cue, 4/4, and you can feel the downbeat coming. The downbeat is the kick. Deafness breaks the telegraph but not the beat." "The count stutters — ONE-two-THREE-and— the kick comes on the off-beat, where your dancing feet aren’t." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Mateo says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Howard says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 38] Asher: The fire settles. Asher has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Redactor — I put it down today." "Its white edge-handles grab toward you — pointing. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph." "The black bars peel off the page — the redacted things come back, wrong and angry." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai says "Did it look at you? Before?" Mateo mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 39] Asher: The fire settles. Asher has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunback — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still and arches its back to the sun. The mirror-scales catch the light — the glare builds, builds — then it launches, blind-fast, straight at where you were standing." "The thick tail lifts off the ground, swaying once — then sweeps like a felled tree. A monitor's tail is a battering ram with scales." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Mateo breathes "We've been walking past those." Ramon says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 41] Asher: The fire settles. Asher has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Meera mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Ramon mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 42] Asher: The fire settles. Asher has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ducks in a row — I put it down today." "The hissing stops. The line leans forward — it advances, and contact burns." "Every beak in the line, one coordinated bite." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Lena says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Mateo says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 42] Howard: The fire settles. Howard has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Asher breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Hassan says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 44] Howard: The fire settles. Howard has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Performance Review — I put it down today." "A red line draws itself across the ground. 3.2 stars. 'ASSESSMENT IN PROGRESS.' Do not be on the line." "It stamps the air. REJECTED. The word has weight." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Lena says "Say that again — slower." Francisco mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 50] Asher: The fire settles. Asher has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ramon says quietly "So it bleeds." Fatima breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 50] Mateo: The fire settles. Mateo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai asks "Say that again — slower." Meera mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 51] Francisco: The fire settles. Francisco has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Inspiration — I put it down today." "It brightens. The light is too white, too certain. EUREKA — the biggest burst so far." "It flickers — a smaller, meaner idea. Less certain, faster." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Hassan mutters "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 64] Francisco: The fire settles. Francisco has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ramon says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Nikolai mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 65] Mateo: The fire settles. Mateo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Bulldozer — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Fatima says "And you're still standing." Lena asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 123] Elena: The fire settles. Elena has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Landlord — I put it down today." "It plants a sign in the ground around you. NOTICE SERVED. The ground is claimed." "You ended your turn on claimed ground. The rent is due. It rises with every Addendum." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hassan mutters "We've been walking past those." Meera mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 127] Maya: The fire settles. Maya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Grief Counselor — I put it down today." "It turns. On its brow, like a mask: YOUR FACE. It lowers its head. It is going to show you yourself, at speed." "You dodged — it WHEELS. A second charge, no windup, aimed at where you are NOW." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Fatima asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 137] Maya: The fire settles. Maya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Herald — I put it down today." "It raises its trumpet. A line of sky goes WHITE — that's where the sound will land. MOVE." "It turns, slowly, and TWO patches of sky go white. It is showing you where NOT to stand. Split up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Elena asks "The fire feels smaller now." Hassan says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 144] Mangapul: The fire settles. Mangapul has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Union Rep — I put it down today." "'BROTHERS! SISTERS!' Allied monsters hit harder. The speech is the weapon." "'WHO'S WITH ME?' Help is coming." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Elena asks "Say that again — slower." Hassan breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 146] Mangapul: The fire settles. Mangapul has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Lockpick — I put it down today." "It sits up. Its hands move too fast to follow. Something you own is suddenly in its hands." "Cornered, it shows its teeth. It fights second — but it fights." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Elena breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Lena mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
vetKillerTaleLog: [day 74] Elijah: The fire settles. Elijah leans in, and the hall goes quiet in a different way — this is not a new story. "You all know The Suburb by now. I put another one down today." "The streetlights FLICKER before the tax. The houses have teeth (of course). The 'for sale' signs count down your remaining rests. It offers safety, warmth, normalcy — a real choice: rest inside and heal, but each rest costs a memory or a bond." "A notice flutters onto your chest — ‘VIOLATION: lawn.’ The lawns lean in. The lawns have always been leaning in." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Meera breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light nods, slow. "We know the name. We know the hand, too."
